en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard view of a leafy riverside promenade with grand residential or institutional buildings partly visible behind dense trees and a masonry fence. On the right side, a tall church or town-hall tower with a spire rises above the treeline. The scene is tranquil, showing the river or canal in the foreground. At the top of the card there is printed text in German.
